summary: Verified fix for 'destroy is not a function' runtime error in admin pages Categories/Zones/Products after login. All three pages load without errors, tables render correctly, add-product dialog opens. Regression pages (/admin dashboard, /admin/orders, /admin/offers) render without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: useEffect fix correctly applied in Categories.jsx, Zones.jsx, Products.jsx: useEffect(() => { load(); }, []) avoids returning the axios promise as cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login works. Categories page renders 14 rows, Zones 3 rows, Products 131 rows. Add product dialog opens. Zero page errors and zero console errors observed across /admin, /admin/categories, /admin/zones, /admin/products, /admin/orders, /admin/offers.
rca of the issue: Original bug: useEffect(load, []) passed axios call result (a Promise) as cleanup, causing React to invoke '.destroy()' during unmount. Fix wraps in arrow function so effect returns undefined. Verified via runtime test.
